description: This file implements fault injection capabilities for Orleans grain storage providers, including a decorator class 'FaultInjectionGrainStorage' that adds delay and exception injection to storage operations for testing purposes. It also defines options classes and a factory for creating instances of this decorator.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Options class specifying fault injection parameters like latency for the storage provider.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorage
classes.description: Decorator class implementing IGrainStorage and ILifecycleParticipant to inject faults and delays into storage operations for testing.

classes.name: FaultInjectionGrainStorageFactory
classes.description: Static factory class to create instances of FaultInjectionGrainStorage.

methods.name: InsertDelay
methods.description: Implements a delay based on the configured latency.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state from storage, with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes state to storage, with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears state in storage, with fault injection capabilities.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Allows the storage provider to participate in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create FaultInjectionGrainStorage instances.
